name: Nova Agritech Limited
summary: Nova Agritech Limited manufactures, distributes, and markets agricultural inputs. It offers on soil health management; crop nutrition; bio stimulant products; bio pesticide; integrated pest management (IPM); new technologies; and crop protection products. The company is also involved in the production of crop seeds. Nova Agritech Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Siddipet, India.
